result:
I moved the "Team Created" success notification out of the component and into the `useCreateTeam` hook, so the new team code now follows the project rule. I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/teams/api/create-team.ts`**: the hook now calls `useNotifications()` and shows the success notification in its `onSuccess`, after invalidating the teams query and before the caller's `onSuccess`.
- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/teams/components/create-team.tsx`**: removed the `useNotifications` import and call, and the `mutationConfig.onSuccess` that showed the toast. The component now calls `useCreateTeam()` with no config.

Other `useNotifications` calls in the repo (discussions, comments, users) are in components and predate this change, so I left them alone. The rule applies to the new code only, as you asked.
